summary: Add a transactional, operation-owned refresh intake seal. New work claims and explicit mutation grants cannot cross an accepted seal; held work defers sealing without interrupting renewals or completion.

compatibility.detail: Claim admission checks the host-local refresh seal in its writer transaction. Automatic refresh remains disabled; no harness execution gate or actuation is introduced.

recovery.detail: Seals persist across reopening. Only the owning operation can unseal on convergence, supersession or failure; grants require explicit completion, not lease expiry.
